desc:
You are a legendary Detective, you've been invited to the prestigious Resort high in the mountains for an exclusive investigation assignment. The resort's Director, Eleanor Vance, has requested your expertise to solve what appears to be a simple accident, but something feels very off about this case... Can you figure it out?

🤝 The game can be played with up to 6 players, so invite your friends!

🕹️ CONTROLS:
💻 PC: Sprint (Left Shift) Crouch (C)
📱 Phone: Sprint (Sprint Button) Crouch (Crouch Button)
🎮 Console: Sprint (L1) Crouch (B)

WARNING: Contains Flashing Lights and Loud Jumpscares!

LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ the game for more ENDINGS!
